philosophy.title: Vhetra’s Philosophy | Web Design, Visual Identity & Digital Presence
philosophy.intro: We don’t make disconnected deliverables. We build brands that work as complete systems.
philosophy.body1: Vhetra brings together technology, design, and strategy to turn good ideas into brands with presence. A brand is more than a logo. It is the relationship between its digital architecture, visual identity, and online experience.
philosophy.body2: We create websites and digital ecosystems for brands, founders, and businesses that want to communicate with focus and consistency. Our sites are fast, accessible, and effortless to use on every screen, pairing Next.js, React, and modern technology with considered creative direction.
philosophy.body3: We don’t design for the next trend cycle. We create systems with character—made to perform and built to last.
philosophy.body4: We balance structure with sensitivity: code with a point of view.

services.heading: DIGITAL WORK THAT
services.presenciaDigitalMini: A polished website and visual identity, designed to work together
services.presenciaDigitalFull:
A website paired with a clear visual identity, so your brand communicates professionally across your website and social media. Ideal for businesses and projects that need a consistent presence across every digital channel.

Includes:

  • Landing page (A simple website that presents your business and captures inquiries)
  • Adaptation of an existing logo
  • Typography selection (The fonts your brand will use)
  • Color palette (The colors that will represent your brand visually)
  • Basic visual kit (Graphic elements that keep your look consistent)
  • Social media identity adaptation
  • 6 initial Instagram posts (Ready-to-publish design assets)


Optional monthly maintenance can include new posts each month.
services.marcaDigitalMini: A complete brand system, brought to life online
services.marcaDigitalFull:
A complete visual system paired with a website built around your business's specific needs. Ideal for brands that need more than a basic informational site.

Includes:

  • Custom website development (May include appointment booking, service catalogs, reservations, or other features)
  • Branding (Logo design or redesign, plus a visual identity system)
  • Typography and color selection
  • Social media adaptation
  • 6 initial social media posts

Available as an ongoing monthly service that may include:

  • Social media post management

services.presenciaEnRedesMini: A clear visual direction for showing up with confidence
services.presenciaEnRedesFull:
A visual and strategic foundation to help your brand communicate professionally on social media. Ideal for businesses or projects launching their Instagram presence with a clear identity, cohesive content, and an initial plan that makes it easier to stay active.

Includes:

  • 30 edited photos (Optimized for social media, with attention to color, framing, and visual style)
  • 9 initial feed posts (Designed around the brand's visual identity to create an attractive, cohesive profile from the start)
  • One-month content calendar (Post ideas and topics planned to keep communication organized and consistent)
  • Existing logo adaptation (If needed, so it works properly on social media)

projects.spaHeading: EVERY PROJECT HAS ITS OWN POINT OF VIEW.
projects.spaAccent: THE GOAL IS ALWAYS THE SAME: MAKE IT MATTER.
projects.salesIntro: From company websites and e-commerce to digital menus and custom platforms, we build useful digital tools that make information clearer, buying easier, and next steps obvious.
projects.subtitle: A selection of work shaped by that idea.
projects.whatsappMessage: Hi! I’d like to talk about a project with Vhetra.

acrodata.titulo: A digital experience designed for movement.
acrodata.descripcionP1: An interactive platform built around a digital library of Acroyoga cards and a tool for creating custom sequences.
acrodata.descripcionP2: Users can explore dozens of poses by difficulty, then open detailed cards with photography, names, and guidance for each figure. We also created a playful random-card tool, making it easy to select, rearrange, and build a practice flow of your own.
acrodata.descripcionP3: Classes, learning resources, and supporting content sit within the same clear, fluid experience—optimized for learning on the go.
acrodata.descripcionP4: The challenge was to turn a rich educational archive into one engaging digital space for discovery, learning, and play.

estacionAlemania.titulo: A digital experience for discovering the history and flavors of Estación Alemania.
estacionAlemania.descripcionP1: We developed a digital menu that allows visitors to explore the venue's food and drink offering quickly, clearly, and intuitively from any device.
estacionAlemania.descripcionP2: The site was structured around a seamless user experience, making the full menu easy to browse in both Spanish and English—especially helpful for tourists and local visitors alike. Direct links to social media, contact information, and directions make it easy to connect with and find the venue.
estacionAlemania.descripcionP3: Alongside the digital menu, the platform shares the story of the former railway station and the Interpretation Center housed in the same space. The content is organized clearly and accessibly without getting in the way of the browsing experience.
estacionAlemania.descripcionP4: The result is an easy-to-manage digital tool, optimized for mobile and designed to make every visit to the venue smoother.

laboragro.titulo: A corporate website for agricultural testing services.
laboragro.descripcionP1: We developed a corporate website that presents agricultural testing services clearly, professionally, and accessibly to a wide range of users.
laboragro.descripcionP2: The site's structure was designed to organize a large amount of technical information without compromising the browsing experience. Through a carefully planned content architecture, visitors can quickly access the different analysis services, learn about the laboratory's certifications, and find relevant information about processes, quality standards, and sampling.
laboragro.descripcionP3: The project prioritized visual clarity and easy access to information, turning complex content into an intuitive, well-organized experience. Navigation was also optimized for mobile devices, and multiple contact points were incorporated to make communication with potential clients easier.
laboragro.descripcionP4: The result is a solid institutional platform designed to convey trust, professionalism, and technical credibility, aligned with the laboratory's track record and specialization.

chaUsandivaras.titulo: A clear, simple real estate platform aligned with the brand's identity.
chaUsandivaras.descripcionP1: We developed a real estate platform focused on simplicity, clarity, and ease of use, adapting every design decision to the client's visual identity and specific needs.
chaUsandivaras.descripcionP2: The project was built with a responsive approach, ensuring a consistent and comfortable experience across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. The interface prioritizes intuitive navigation, allowing users to explore properties quickly and easily while reducing friction and making the most relevant information easy to access.
chaUsandivaras.descripcionP3: The platform includes a filtering system to speed up the property search, helping users find listings according to different criteria efficiently. We also developed a clear and accessible contact section to encourage direct communication between potential clients and the real estate agency.
chaUsandivaras.descripcionP4: The result is an elegant, functional digital tool designed to provide a simple, fluid experience aligned with the business's commercial goals.

flavia.titulo: A modern digital menu built for simplicity and quick access.
flavia.descripcionP1: We developed a modern digital menu focused on simplicity, quick access, and a clean browsing experience from any device.
flavia.descripcionP2: The project was designed around a clear client requirement: remove unnecessary elements and prioritize only the essential information. The interface uses a minimalist, intuitive structure that lets users explore the menu naturally, without distractions or visual overload, making it comfortable to read on both mobile and desktop devices.
flavia.descripcionP3: To add identity without compromising the overall simplicity, we incorporated a 3D animation created in Blender and integrated it subtly into the experience. This element brings personality to the site while preserving the clean, elegant aesthetic that guided the entire project.
flavia.descripcionP4: The result is a responsive, fast, and visually balanced platform where design and functionality work together to highlight the food offering clearly and directly.

loza.titulo: An end-to-end website for selling, content management, and user administration.
loza.descripcionP1: We developed an end-to-end website that brings e-commerce, content management, and user administration together in one seamless digital solution.
loza.descripcionP2: The project was designed with close attention to the user experience, prioritizing clear, intuitive navigation so visitors can find information, reserve a spot in workshops, request custom ceramic pieces, or make purchases quickly and easily. Every section was planned and structured around UX principles to improve conversion and make the site journey feel effortless.
loza.descripcionP3: Beyond the public-facing experience, we developed an admin dashboard that allows products, orders, content, and users to be managed without technical knowledge, giving the studio autonomy and flexibility to keep the platform up to date.
loza.descripcionP4: The online store is integrated with Mercado Pago to process payments securely, while user authentication and the database support advanced features and efficient management of all site information.

filiSuites.titulo: A visual identity made for the digital world.
filiSuites.descripcionP1: For Fili Suites, we shaped the social media identity and Instagram content direction around the space itself—its colors, textures, and atmosphere.
filiSuites.descripcionP2: The result is a calm, warm, and professional presence that feels true to the guest experience.
